author: AutisticDisciple
title: Muted Sage theme is a miracle for my eyes
content: Most church apps use bright harsh white or jarring orange buttons. Belong's Muted Sage theme with subdued green tones lets me read Psalm 139 reflections for an hour without eye strain or sensory fatigue.

author: QuietPrayerWarrior
title: Zero-anxiety calm notifications: no sudden buzzes
content: I love that notifications are batched twice daily and completely silent by default. I can check the bell icon when I am emotionally ready rather than being startled throughout the workday.

author: SoundscapeSeeker
title: Quiet Room rainfall soundscape helps me decompress
content: When I had a sensory meltdown after work yesterday, I opened the Quiet Room tab and listened to the gentle rainfall while meditating on Psalm 139:14. It grounded my nervous system immediately.

author: DFW_AutisticAdult
title: Safe Christian community with zero social masking
content: For years I felt alienated in traditional church groups where you are expected to make constant eye contact and endure loud fellowship halls. Belong is a true sanctuary where my neurodivergence is celebrated as God's design.

author: CodeAndFaith
title: Silky smooth 120fps scrolling on Pixel 9a
content: Unlike Circle which stutters with WebView lag, Belong scrolls at buttery smooth 120fps on my Pixel. Instant cold launch and zero frame drops.

author: ScriptureLover
title: Meaningful reflection prompt cards
content: The daily scripture prompts and care affirmations (Praying 🙏, Support 🤍) create such an uplifting space. No toxic thumbs-down or angry emojis.

author: HighContrastReader
title: High contrast mode with yellow accents is perfect
content: My visual processing sensitivity requires deep black and bright yellow borders. Belong's high-contrast mode passes AAA contrast standards and looks gorgeous.

author: SubwayCommuter
title: Reads discussions offline on the subway
content: I lost signal in the transit tunnel and was still able to read fellowship posts and scripture verses without interruption. Excellent local caching.

author: RoadmapVoter
title: Community feature voting gives members a real voice
content: Being able to upvote community features like direct messages and calendar meetups directly in the app makes us feel valued as co-builders.

author: ParentOfAutisticSon
title: A blessing for our whole family
content: My adult autistic son has struggled to find Christian fellowship where he feels safe. Belong has given him authentic friends who understand his special interests.

author: AmberThemeFan
title: Warm Amber theme is so cozy for evening reading
content: The candlelit amber tones eliminate harsh blue light completely before bedtime. I read daily reflections without disrupting my sleep.

author: MonogramAppreciator
title: Clean monogram avatar badges and tagline
content: Profile cards showing initials and special interest taglines ('Trains & Hymns') allow us to introduce ourselves without photo anxiety.

author: GentleFellow
title: Love the app, would like larger font scaling in comments
content: The general feed text scales nicely with Android system font size, but nested comment replies could use slightly larger line spacing for readability.

author: MusicLover99
title: Quiet Room is awesome, please add gentle stream sound
content: The rainfall track is peaceful! Adding a mountain stream or gentle forest breeze track to the Quiet Room would be fantastic.

author: DiscussionContributor
title: Draft recovery works great, add bold markdown shortcuts
content: I love the unhurried draft autosave so nothing gets lost. Having a quick format bar for bold and bullet lists would make formatting even easier.

author: BibleStudentMark
title: Psalm 139:14 is a perfect anchor verse
content: 'Fearfully and wonderfully made' reminds me daily of my identity in Christ. Looking forward to more scripture study spaces opening up.

author: CareTeamVolunteer
title: Gentle care affirmations are so encouraging
content: Sending a quiet prayer affirmation to someone having a tough day takes two taps and means the world to them. Wonderful pastoral tool.

author: TabletUserRachel
title: Runs nicely on phone, tablet layout could be wider
content: On my iPad mini it works well, but on my 12.9-inch iPad Pro I would love a split-screen view with spaces on the left and feed on the right.

author: CalendarOrganizer
title: Eagerly waiting for the events calendar tab
content: The discussion boards and reflections are peaceful. Once the Actually Autistic meetup calendar ships with RSVP, this will be my daily home.

author: BetaTesterTim
title: Feedback drawing canvas crashed once when rotating screen
content: When I was sketching on the feedback canvas and rotated my phone from portrait to landscape, the drawing strokes reset. Rotating back restored the screen.
